implementation: New or replaced session binding presents a checking state until the server determines whether a code is required.
Personal/Family app and Business route background checks/code submission through the existing loading view instead of flashing the full verification form.

The shared verification view hides its heading, trust controls and code actions while checking, verifying or completing approval; a compact accessible status and spinner are shown where that view is used.
Locked/code-required, wrong-code, forbidden and unavailable states remain visible and actionable; no mail is sent merely by opening the view.
Callback entry reuses a current actor/bearer-bound ticket for adjacent continuation instead of repeating prepare. Independent current remote-user and server-proof checks still precede adoption.
Successful password save explicitly locks the old callback approval even if the bearer does not change. A denied independent proof locks it again and exposes retry.
Recovery keeps automatic same-account adoption; invitation account choices and unfinished Admin setup remain explicit.
Cache versions bumped for app, Business, recovery, shared entry, verification module and both stylesheets. Reduced-motion preference is respected.
scope_limit: Addresses identified verification-screen flashes and one duplicate RPC; unspecified glitches and live timing need owner review after deployment. No speed SLA or wall-clock improvement is inferred from fixtures.
requested_owner_action_now: Prepare the new ZIP from the accepted auto-signin ZIP. After exit0 upload only the new ZIP to mushavo-budget-staging and return safe JSON/new URL. No new password recovery, code/email or timed SQL action requested during packaging.
subsequent_live_validation: After deployment verify trusted-browser startup and post-code continuation stay on loading until the dashboard. Show code controls only when the server requires a fresh code. Preserve bounded staging readiness for any later recovery retry.
